title: M2 epic: arXiv Source + enrichers, end-to-end into Library
description:
Milestone M2 from ROADMAP.md. Goal: prove the ingestion contract by reimplementing arXiv all the way into the Library with structure and citation enrichments attached.

Discharges: §6 test #3 (partial — proves ingest→library for one source; full mixing proven at M3).

Architecture decisions in effect:
- ADR-011 (to be written): Option A enrichment model — Python assembles fully-enriched RawDocument; Rust ingests once. Re-enrichment path deferred to M3.
- Job coordination: synchronous subprocess (Python writes job file → calls alcanzai ingest-job → reads result.json).
- OTel: not in scope for M2 (deferred to v0.3.0).
- GROBID endpoint: ALCANZAI_GROBID_URL env var, default http://localhost:8070.

Done-conditions (self-checkable):
1. alcanzai ingest 1706.03762 → KO in Library with structure + citation enrichments → vault note exists after render.
2. Re-ingesting same ID is a no-op (ExactMatch dedup).
3. Diff of Library/projection/synthesis modules shows zero edits (only ingestion + understanding modules changed).

Salvage files (read-only reference):
- prototype/paper_library/arxiv_fetcher.py
- prototype/paper_library/grobid_processor.py
- prototype/paper_library/citation_context.py
